beats.text: Bond yields have been climbing all month, so Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent just doubled down on buying bonds back to calm the market.
Fair enough, Trump said -- Bessent's just very good at this. A follow-up question pushed further.

beats.caption: Have you talked to him about another type of intervention? Is that something he will be doing?
beats.label: via Forbes Breaking News

beats.caption: We have many types of intervention. That's one.
beats.label: via Forbes Breaking News

beats.caption: The ultimate intervention is our military.
beats.label: via Forbes Breaking News

beats.text: Nobody appears to have told the actual Pentagon about this plan.

beats.caption: And if we have to use that, we will.
beats.label: via Forbes Breaking News

beats.text: Wall Street was left trying to figure out what that even meant. CNN's Abby Phillip wasn't buying it either, telling viewers flatly: what is he talking about?
